opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Society Representatives and Fellows can apply to host events such as internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach activities.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers who need additional support to achieve their potential.
opportunities.summary: Supports postdoctoral researchers with additional funding for research activities.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research addressing key questions in physiological education.
opportunities.summary: Supports development of novel physiology teaching resources or educational research.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, finalize projects, and promote knowledge transfer and impact.
opportunities.summary: Supports pilot studies, technique development, and activities to promote knowledge exchange.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full or Fellow members in their second year of membership or longer, to run activities addressing equity, diversity and inclusion.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for members to run activities that address equity, diversity and inclusion principles.
